hero.title: North Wind Restaurant: Bangalore's Landmark for Exquisite Coorg & Mangalorean Dining
hero.subtitle: Since 1988, North Wind Restaurant has been a cherished landmark for connoisseurs, offering an unparalleled roof garden dining experience alongside delectable regional Indian cuisine.

about.title: A Legacy of Fine Dining
about.paragraph1: Established in 1988, North Wind Restaurant quickly became a prominent landmark in North Bangalore. Its inauguration by the former Prime Minister of India, Sri HD Deve Gowda, set the stage for what would become a cherished destination for discerning connoisseurs of fine dining.
about.paragraph2: From its inception, the exquisite aromas emanating from our kitchen have drawn guests, creating a reputation for delectable delicacies. We proudly specialize in authentic Coorg and Mangalorean culinary delights, served amidst the serene ambiance of our unique roof garden experience.
